Potatoes: there are about 7 chunks, each roughly 3 cm across and 1.5–2 cm thick, so about 15–20 g each. That gives about 120 g.

Cucumber or melon: the pieces are pale green cubes, probably honeydew melon or cucumber. There are about 14 pieces at roughly 8–10 g each, so about 110 g. They look like honeydew, at about 36 kcal per 100 g.

Bacon: there are about 4 cooked strips. Each cooked strip weighs about 8 g, so about 30 g in total.
